setting.help: Choose which incoming payment methods of your cash and bank journals reps can record, what they're called, and whether reps enter a reference or cheque details.
Reps can show customers a QR code or share a link to pay an invoice online with the payment providers enabled here.

setting.string: Invoice van deliveries at the shop
setting.help: Reps post the tax invoice for what they hand over from the van and print it on a thermal printer or share it. Each van numbers its invoices in its own series (VAN1/2026/00001), so it works without signal. Warehouse deliveries are invoiced by the office as usual.
The slip printed by reps and from Odoo's Print menu. Customers without a TRN get a simplified tax invoice.

Reps sign in to the BeatPro app with their Odoo email and password; Odoo then gives each phone its own API key, listed on the user's profile (Security tab) where it can be revoked. Set each rep's discount limit on the BeatPro tab of their user.
